source_of_truth: validation/scientific_closure_register.json is canonical; EN/VI validation README entries summarize the same dispositions.
scope: Scientific validity only; not clean-code or performance audit; no live EE credentials in review environment
rule: A numerical invariant is not a field validation. A descriptive claim can be bounded without estimating unavailable economic quantities. Missing external evidence cannot be closed by synthetic data.
accepted_for_descriptive_use: Only with documented source, grid, processing policy, A02 support audit, LISA settings and known inferential limits
next_hard_inputs: One real VIIRS VCMSLCFG district-year with A02-verified incomplete support and nonzero cloud-free observations plus source monthly cf_cvg
Independent pixels or counts to validate observation masks
Geocoded real economic comparator if economic/CBD claim is desired
Multi-year panel if stationary Markov claim is desired

disposition.claim_ceiling: Corr(z,Wz) is only a cross-sectional correlation
disposition.evidence_needed: Explicit spatial autoregression / unit-root research design

disposition.claim_ceiling: 5/15/40 are fixed radiance bands, not economic classes
disposition.evidence_needed: Independent multi-locality land-use/economic labels for calibration

disposition.claim_ceiling: Distance-weighted NTL is descriptive light potential, not economic market access
disposition.evidence_needed: Independent employment/population plus transport friction and target market outcomes

disposition.claim_ceiling: NTL-selected center and in-sample R2 do not verify economic CBD
disposition.evidence_needed: Independent geocoded job/activity center with matched date/support

disposition.claim_ceiling: Hill and conditional iid bootstrap do not establish a spatial Pareto law
disposition.evidence_needed: Data-dependent tail-cutoff refit and spatially calibrated null simulations

disposition.claim_ceiling: signed_dist_hh_km is distance between cell centers, not polygon boundaries
disposition.evidence_needed: Boundary geometry only if user wants an actual boundary-distance estimand

disposition.claim_ceiling: Chronology year_t0 < year_t1 guarded and tested
disposition.evidence_needed: None for chronology; longitudinal causality remains a separate question

disposition.claim_ceiling: Undefined 4-state Shorrocks for empty source quartiles guarded and tested
disposition.evidence_needed: Multiyear panel to interpret Markov dynamics beyond two observations

disposition.claim_ceiling: A02 counts valid months; optional cf_cvg count diagnostic distinguishes source observations
disposition.evidence_needed: Real sparse-observation VIIRS location-year and independent monthly cf_cvg reference

disposition.claim_ceiling: UTM-by-bbox-center is not a globally reliable distance/area estimator
disposition.evidence_needed: Independent geodesic/equal-area control at poles/dateline/multizone regions

disposition.claim_ceiling: Residual Moran large-grid I threshold is descriptive only, no pseudo p
disposition.evidence_needed: Valid permutation/reference test for inferential label on large grids

disposition.claim_ceiling: GHSL nearest epoch may differ from VIIRS year; gap exposed
disposition.evidence_needed: Independent contemporaneous proxy to claim same-year validity
Predeclared empirical sensitivity for any universal threshold claim

disposition.claim_ceiling: moran_I_lit is mean local I, not global Moran I
disposition.evidence_needed: None if exported metric and UI are correctly described

disposition.claim_ceiling: Evidence catalog matches production VCMSLCFG product
disposition.evidence_needed: Recheck only if the dataset identifier changes

disposition.claim_ceiling: BH/BY simulations do not validate field LISA null p-values or PRDS
